name: The Shattered Salute
summary: In Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow, Shenthul teaches a silent sign to new rogues. The Shattered Hand uses it to recognize its agents safely in the field.

sections.title: Signs and Shadows
sections.body: In Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow, the Shattered Hand works in secrecy as Thrall's Horde intelligence and assassination arm. Its agents cannot use banners or military signs on dangerous, secret assignments. Shenthul teaches newly inducted rogues the Shattered Salute, a silent gesture that lets allies recognize one another.

sections.title: Preparation for the Field
sections.body: For Shenthul's rogues, learning the salute is vital tradecraft, not ceremony. Agents sent into danger or to infiltrate rival factions need to verify contacts without alerting bystanders or targets. Before entrusting an agent with covert fieldwork, Shenthul expects them to recognize and mirror the gesture without hesitation.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Shattered Salute?
aliases: why do i need the salute
faq.answer: The Shattered Salute lets Shattered Hand agents recognize one another, even in deep cover or hostile territory, without revealing their ties to outsiders.

aliases: where do i learn the salute
faq.answer: Shenthul, a rogue trainer stationed deep within Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow, teaches the salute.
The Shattered Hand uses the gesture. Orcish rogues, spies, and assassins of the order serve Thrall's Horde from Orgrimmar's shadows.

faq.q: Why is learning the salute necessary before going into the field?
faq.answer: Agents on infiltration assignments use the salute to contact undercover allies without exposing their cover or mistaking an enemy for one.

faq.q: Where does this training take place?
faq.answer: Training takes place in the Cleft of Shadow, a subterranean district beneath Orgrimmar where rogues, warlocks, and other practitioners of forbidden arts gather away from public scrutiny.

faq.q: What assignment follows after mastering the salute?
faq.answer: After Shenthul is satisfied with an agent's mastery, he assigns them to deep cover operations. The assignment tests their ability to use the signal to contact agents in the field.

angles.text: As a Horde rogue, you learn the Shattered Hand's secret signals and move from ordinary cutpurse to trusted agent of Orgrimmar's intelligence network.
As a member of the Horde, you serve under Warchief Thrall, who leads with honor. The Horde also relies on the Shattered Hand's secret methods to stop threats before they reach the surface.
